name: Density scaling
description: Density-adaptive parameter selection (spec 05-routing.md 9.4, 9.10; EstimateDensity per 02a-coordinated-capacity.md 2a.10.3). Given the node's DensityEstimate D (u8, 0..255), selects ANNOUNCE_INTERVAL, MAX_ANNOUNCE_HOPS, GRADIENT_TIMEOUT (= 2x interval), and ANNOUNCE_JITTER (= interval/10 capped at 120 s) per the 9.4 adaptive tier table; computes root num_slots = MAX(8, CEIL(dodag_size/25)) per 9.10.4; and selects the position beacon interval per 12-apps.md 18.2.1 (60 s moving / 300 s stationary baseline) with the dense-deployment rule that density > 20 floors the interval at 300 s. Tier boundaries are inclusive on the upper edge as written in the 9.4 table (moderate 5-20, dense 21-50, very dense 51-100, extreme > 100; sparse < 5, so D=4 is sparse and D=5 is moderate).
spec: spec/05-routing.md sections 9.4 and 9.10; spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md section 2a.10.3; spec/12-apps.md section 18.2.1

announce_parameters.name: sparse_tier
announce_parameters.description: D=4 (< 5) is sparse: 300 s interval, 15 hops, 600 s gradient timeout, 30 s jitter

announce_parameters.name: moderate_lower_boundary
announce_parameters.description: D=5 is the first moderate value (sparse is strictly < 5)

announce_parameters.name: moderate_tier
announce_parameters.description: D=12 is moderate: 300 s interval, 10 hops, 600 s gradient timeout, 30 s jitter

announce_parameters.name: moderate_upper_boundary
announce_parameters.description: D=20 is the last moderate value (moderate is 5-20 inclusive)

announce_parameters.name: dense_lower_boundary
announce_parameters.description: D=21 is the first dense value (dense is 21-50 inclusive)

announce_parameters.name: dense_tier
announce_parameters.description: D=35 is dense: 600 s interval, 5 hops, 1200 s gradient timeout, 60 s jitter

announce_parameters.name: dense_upper_boundary
announce_parameters.description: D=50 is the last dense value

announce_parameters.name: very_dense_lower_boundary
announce_parameters.description: D=51 is the first very-dense value (very dense is 51-100 inclusive)

announce_parameters.name: very_dense_tier
announce_parameters.description: D=75 is very dense: 1200 s interval, 3 hops, 2400 s gradient timeout, 120 s jitter

announce_parameters.name: very_dense_upper_boundary
announce_parameters.description: D=100 is the last very-dense value

announce_parameters.name: extreme_lower_boundary
announce_parameters.description: D=101 is the first extreme value (extreme is > 100): 1800 s interval, 2 hops, 3600 s gradient timeout, jitter capped at 120 s

announce_parameters.name: extreme_saturated
announce_parameters.description: D=255 (EstimateDensity saturation ceiling) remains extreme with jitter capped at 120 s (1800/10 = 180 would exceed the cap)

announce_parameters.name: zero_density
announce_parameters.description: D=0 is sparse: full-rate announce parameters

num_slots_scaling.name: exactly_one_node_per_slot
num_slots_scaling.description: dodag_size=200 gives ceil(200/25)=8, at the minimum

num_slots_scaling.name: large_dodag
num_slots_scaling.description: dodag_size=1000 gives ceil(1000/25)=40 (Burning Man per-BR reference range)

position_beacon_rate.name: sparse_moving
position_beacon_rate.description: D=10 (below dense threshold): 60 s moving-beacon baseline per 18.2.1

position_beacon_rate.name: sparse_stationary
position_beacon_rate.description: D=10 (below dense threshold): 300 s stationary-beacon baseline per 18.2.1

position_beacon_rate.name: dense_threshold_boundary_moving
position_beacon_rate.description: D=20 is still below the dense threshold: moving beacons stay at the 60 s baseline

position_beacon_rate.name: dense_lower_boundary_moving
position_beacon_rate.description: D=21 crosses the dense threshold: moving beacons floor at 300 s

position_beacon_rate.name: extreme_stationary
position_beacon_rate.description: D=255 at extreme density: stationary beacons remain at 300 s (the dense floor)
